title: Against the Claw by Shari Randall
description:
Small’s Novels & Nibbles is diving into a cozy seaside mystery where former ballerina, Allie Larkin, heads to the Connecticut coast to help at her Aunt Gully’s Lazy Mermaid lobster shack. She is expecting a quiet reset complete with lobster rolls and “Lobster Love Sauce” (Aunt Gully’s secret sauce), but instead finds herself entangled in summer theater drama, quirky small-town secrets, and even a murder! Oh No, said with bated breath!

A buttery toasted brioche roll from PBO’s The Bread Shop loaded to the gills with wild-caught lobster, fresh chives, crisp celery, creamy mayo, a breeze of Old Bay, and a squeeze of lemon, and finished with a warm drizzle of butter giving it that “Love Lobster Sauce” magic.

Grab a seat, a lobster roll and send your taste buds on a culinary seaside vacay!
